_about: Machine and project settings read by tools/hub.py and the hooks in .claude/hooks/. Shipped with defaults; hub-setup fills the nulls (orchestration/05_SETUP_PROTOCOL.md, Step 6). Safe to edit by hand; keep it valid JSON. commit.banned is for project-specific extra patterns ({"pattern": <regex>, "why": <text>}): they are added to the guard's built-in list of hub ids and names (.claude/hooks/safety_guard.py, DEFAULT_BANNED), which this file cannot shrink - so it ships empty and an engine update can refine the built-in list. context_budget ships for a 200k window; on a 1M-context model set context_window 1000000 and warn/handoff/stop 150000/350000/400000 (the hook also does this itself the first time a session passes 200k).
